info.title: Common Horizon API
info.description:
Backend bridge between the Common Horizon website and the lunar physics engine.

**The physics engine calculates; the backend validates and passes results through.**
Every response states its data source in `provenance`. While the real engine is
being integrated, responses come from a clearly labelled synthetic fixture
(`provenance.is_synthetic = true`).

Units are part of every field name: `_deg` degrees, `_m` metres, `_km` kilometres,
`_s` seconds, `_hours`, `_days`, `_utc` ISO 8601 timestamps in UTC.

get.description: Always cheap: used as the AWS Lambda Web Adapter readiness check. Never runs the engine.

post.summary: Evaluate one landing site and mission window
post.description:
Returns Sun/Earth time series, mission metrics, communication windows,
requirement checks and (optionally) a launch-delay comparison.

Check ``provenance.is_synthetic`` (also sent as the ``X-Data-Source`` header):
synthetic fixtures are placeholders, not physics results.

get.description: Longitudes are degrees east, 0..360. Source: the team's preset list (``web/src/api/examples/sites.json``).

get.summary: Hardware catalog from the planner module
get.description: Every item and figure comes from ``planner.list_catalog()``; unpublished figures are null.

post.summary: Fit and power checks for one site
post.description:
The planner's ``fit_check``, ``power_check`` and ``site_energy``. With a site, the darkness comes from
the physics engine; check ``provenance.is_synthetic``.

One physics run per site, the planner's checks, then Dan's ranking (best first, see ``rank``).

Check ``provenance.is_synthetic`` (also the ``X-Data-Source`` header): synthetic fixtures are not physics.

post.summary: Terrain skyline, the Sun's path and the Earth's box for one site
post.description:
One physics run through the engine interface ``/evaluate`` uses. ``state`` is "above" when any part of
the Sun's disc is visible above the terrain. Check ``provenance.is_synthetic`` (also the ``X-Data-Source``
header): synthetic fixtures are not physics.

Answers one question about the visitor's mission, from the same evaluation ``POST /evaluate`` runs over
the 17 preset sites (and the selected custom point). A language model on Amazon Bedrock words the answer;
it is told to use only the numbers in those results. Text only, at most about 120 words.

503 when the assistant is switched off (``CH_ASSISTANT_ENABLED``), today's cap is reached, or Bedrock
refuses or times out. The cap is counted in memory per running copy and resets each UTC day.

422.description: Invalid request (for example a question over 500 characters) or hardware the planner cannot use

503.description: Assistant unavailable: switched off, today's cap reached, Bedrock refused or timed out, or the physics engine is unavailable

site_id.title: Site Id
site_id.description: The site the visitor has selected: a preset id, a custom point (custom:<lat>:<lon_east>) or null.

storage_kwh.title: Storage Kwh
storage_kwh.description: Battery storage typed by the visitor, kWh. 0 = none.

transit_days.title: Transit Days
transit_days.description: Launch-to-landing time, days (optional; the website does not send it yet). Left out or null: the website's own value, 5 days, as on every POST /evaluate it sends.

AskContext.title: AskContext
AskContext.description: The visitor's current mission, as the website holds it. The same bounds as ``POST /evaluate``.

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: Plain text from the language model, at most about 120 words.

AskResponse.title: AskResponse
AskResponse.description: The website's optional ``example`` flag marks its own mock answers; the backend never sends it.

position_km.title: Position Km
position_km.description: Body position, km, MOON_ME frame, origin at the Moon's centre.

direction_unit.title: Direction Unit
direction_unit.description: Unit vector from the observer to the body, MOON_ME frame.

azimuth_deg.title: Azimuth Deg
azimuth_deg.description: Azimuth, degrees clockwise from local north, 0..360.

elevation_deg.title: Elevation Deg
elevation_deg.description: Elevation above the local horizontal plane, degrees.

visibility_fraction.title: Visibility Fraction
visibility_fraction.description: Fraction of the body's disc visible above terrain, 0..1.

BodyTimeseries.title: BodyTimeseries
BodyTimeseries.description: Sun or Earth as seen from the observer, one entry per timestamp.

capacity_kg.title: Capacity Kg
capacity_kg.description: The value a fit check uses (the low end of a published range).

CatalogFigure.title: CatalogFigure
CatalogFigure.description: One figure exactly as the planner catalog stores it (published unit, status labels, source).

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: lander, cargo (payload mass), power (a power source) or load (a power load). 'load' is new.

mass_kg.title: Mass Kg
mass_kg.description: Payload mass. Null when not published, and for landers, sources and loads (no mass here).

capacity_kg.title: Capacity Kg
capacity_kg.description: Landers only. Null when there are several published figures: see capacity_options.

max_slope_deg.title: Max Slope Deg
max_slope_deg.description: Landers only. Null when no slope limit is published for this lander.

load_day_kw.title: Load Day Kw
load_day_kw.description: Loads only: power drawn in sunlight. Null for other kinds.

load_night_kw.title: Load Night Kw
load_night_kw.description: Loads only: power drawn in darkness. Null for other kinds.

gen_kw.title: Gen Kw
gen_kw.description: Sources only: power produced per unit. Null for other kinds.

gen_needs_sun.title: Gen Needs Sun
gen_needs_sun.description: Sources only: true when it works in sunlight only.

figures.title: Figures
figures.description: The planner's figures behind the numbers above, with status and source.

storage_kwh.title: Storage Kwh
storage_kwh.description: Battery storage typed by the visitor, kWh. 0 = none.

fits.title: Fits
fits.description: Null when the planner cannot decide (several capacity figures, a mass missing).

energy_added_kwh.title: Energy Added Kwh
energy_added_kwh.description: Null: the planner has no net generation-minus-load figure. The energy the site's darkness adds is in site_energy.

site_energy.description: Null when no site is given (no darkness length).

provenance.description: Where the darkness length came from. Null without a site.

is_synthetic.title: Is Synthetic
is_synthetic.description: True when the numbers are placeholder fixtures, not physics results.

notice.title: Notice
notice.description: Human-readable statement of where the numbers come from.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Data sets and models behind the numbers (ephemeris kernels, terrain profile, citations). Empty for the synthetic fixture.

storage_kwh.title: Storage Kwh
storage_kwh.description: Battery storage typed by the visitor, kWh. 0 = none.

transit_days.title: Transit Days
transit_days.description: Launch-to-landing time, days (new, optional). The team has not fixed one: when it is left out the stay starts at launch_utc + slip_days and the response says so in warnings.

transit_days.title: Transit Days
transit_days.description: As sent; null means not stated (counted as 0, with a warning).

time_step_s.title: Time Step S
time_step_s.description: Sampling step the backend chose for every site in this response.

geometry.description: Sub-solar and sub-Earth points at landing_utc, from the engine.

results.title: Results
results.description: Best first, ranked by the backend.

min_sunlight_percentage.title: Min Sunlight Percentage
min_sunlight_percentage.description: Minimum share of the stay with the Sun visible, percent.

min_sunlight_hours.title: Min Sunlight Hours
min_sunlight_hours.description: Minimum total hours with the Sun visible during the stay.

max_darkness_hours.title: Max Darkness Hours
max_darkness_hours.description: Longest continuous darkness the hardware can survive, hours.

min_earth_visibility_percentage.title: Min Earth Visibility Percentage
min_earth_visibility_percentage.description: Minimum share of the stay with Earth visible, percent.

min_earth_visibility_hours.title: Min Earth Visibility Hours
min_earth_visibility_hours.description: Minimum total hours with Earth visible during the stay.

max_slope_deg.title: Max Slope Deg
max_slope_deg.description: Maximum landing-site slope the hardware tolerates, degrees.

HardwareRequirements.title: HardwareRequirements
HardwareRequirements.description: Pass/fail thresholds for a lander or payload. Every field is optional.

assistant_available.title: Assistant Available
assistant_available.description: CH_ASSISTANT_ENABLED as configured (default false). Read from the settings: no network call.

step_hours.title: Step Hours
step_hours.description: Wanted spacing of sun_path samples, hours (one minute to one day). Rounded to whole minutes, and coarsened when the window would need more than 4000 samples (see time_step_s).

skyline.title: Skyline
skyline.description: Skyline sorted by azimuth, evenly spaced, degrees.

earth_box.description: Box around the Earth's sampled directions above the local horizontal plane. Null when the Earth never rises above level during the window.

skyline_source.title: Skyline Source
skyline_source.description: stored_profile: the site's stored terrain horizon profile, at its own spacing. smooth_sphere: no terrain, only the geometric dip of a sphere through the site (see warnings).

time_step_s.title: Time Step S
time_step_s.description: Spacing of sun_path actually used, seconds (whole minutes).

latitude_deg.title: Latitude Deg
latitude_deg.description: Selenographic latitude in degrees, north positive (MOON_ME frame).

longitude_deg.title: Longitude Deg
longitude_deg.description: Selenographic longitude in degrees, east positive, range -180..180 (MOON_ME frame).

altitude_m.title: Altitude M
altitude_m.description: Site elevation in metres relative to the 1737.4 km lunar reference sphere. Null means the engine derives it from terrain data.

requirements_passed.title: Requirements Passed
requirements_passed.description: Null when no requirements were given or checkable.

launch_delay_results.title: Launch Delay Results
launch_delay_results.description: Empty unless launch_delay_days > 0; then includes the 0-day baseline.

observer_height_m.title: Observer Height M
observer_height_m.description: Height of the observer (camera, antenna, panel) above the local surface, metres.

mission_start_utc.title: Mission Start Utc
mission_start_utc.description: Mission start as an ISO 8601 string with an explicit timezone, e.g. 2027-01-15T00:00:00Z. Normalised to UTC.

stay_duration_days.title: Stay Duration Days
stay_duration_days.description: Length of the surface stay, days.

launch_delay_days.title: Launch Delay Days
launch_delay_days.description: Maximum launch slip to analyse, whole days. 0 disables the analysis; otherwise the mission is re-evaluated for delays 0, step, 2*step, ... up to this value. All cases together may use at most MAX_TOTAL_SAMPLES (20 000 by default) distinct sample timestamps; larger requests are rejected with 422.

launch_delay_step_days.title: Launch Delay Step Days
launch_delay_step_days.description: Spacing between analysed launch delays, whole days.

hardware_id.title: Hardware Id
hardware_id.description: Identifier of the selected lander or payload (letters, digits, '.', '_', '-').

sky_visibility_fraction.title: Sky Visibility Fraction
sky_visibility_fraction.description: Fraction of the sky hemisphere not blocked by terrain.

time_to_sunset_hours.title: Time To Sunset Hours
time_to_sunset_hours.description: Hours from mission start to the first sunset; null if none occurs.

time_to_earthset_hours.title: Time To Earthset Hours
time_to_earthset_hours.description: Hours from mission start to the first Earthset; null if none occurs.

ObstructionState.title: ObstructionState
ObstructionState.description: Why a body is (not) visible from the observer.

requirement.title: Requirement
requirement.description: Name of the field in hardware_requirements.

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: Metric the threshold is compared against.

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: Null when the engine did not provide the metric.

ScoreComponents.title: ScoreComponents
ScoreComponents.description: The four 0..100 terms of the score; null when the input is unknown.

SiteEnergy.title: SiteEnergy
SiteEnergy.description: The planner's ``site_energy``: the energy a site's darkness adds (night load plus heating).

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: Position in this response, 1 = best. The backend owns the order.

score.title: Score
score.description: 0..100. Null when a term is unknown (today: slope); see score_min/max.

score_min.title: Score Min
score_min.description: The score with every unknown term at its worst (0).

score_max.title: Score Max
score_max.description: The score with every unknown term at its best (100).

clear_sky_percent.title: Clear Sky Percent
clear_sky_percent.description: Null when no terrain skyline is available for the site.

slope_source.title: Slope Source
slope_source.description: What slope_deg is, whenever it is given (new). Preset sites with the real engine: 'slope of the best-fit plane to LOLA heights within 500 m (NASA Moon Trek)', a regional slope, wider than a lander.

elevation_m.title: Elevation M
elevation_m.description: Site elevation relative to the 1737.4 km reference sphere, metres.

slope_deg.title: Slope Deg
slope_deg.description: Terrain slope at the site, degrees. Null when unknown; slope_source says what it is.

slope_source.title: Slope Source
slope_source.description: What slope_deg is, whenever it is given. Real engine: 'slope of the best-fit plane to LOLA heights within 500 m (NASA Moon Trek)', a regional slope, wider than a lander.

lon_east.title: Lon East
lon_east.description: Degrees east. 0..360 as the website sends it; -180..0 is accepted and normalised to 0..360.

SiteRef.title: SiteRef
SiteRef.description: A site as the website sends it: a preset, a saved point or a typed coordinate.

SkyBox.title: SkyBox
SkyBox.description: Part of the sky the Earth moves through. az_min greater than az_max means it wraps past north.

az.title: Az
az.description: Azimuth, degrees clockwise from local north, 0..360.

el.title: El
el.description: Elevation of the skyline above the local horizontal plane, degrees.

az.title: Az
az.description: Azimuth of the Sun's centre, degrees clockwise from local north, 0..360.

el.title: El
el.description: Elevation of the Sun's centre above the local horizontal plane, degrees.

state.title: State
state.description: 'above' when the engine says any part of the Sun's disc is visible above the terrain (the rule /evaluate uses for sunlight), else 'hidden'.

TerrainSkyline.title: TerrainSkyline
TerrainSkyline.description: Terrain horizon profile around the site (angular elevation per azimuth).

result.title: Result
result.description: 'unknown' (new) when no requirement fails but one cannot be checked.

requirement.title: Requirement
requirement.description: fail: the first requirement that failed. unknown: the first that could not be checked.

unknown_requirements.title: Unknown Requirements
unknown_requirements.description: Every requirement that could not be checked, in order.
